title: fix(url-sync): let the user go back in history (fix #2171)
body:
To test that the behaviour is fixed, go to the [staging website](http://unhealthy-direction.surge.sh/).

Scenario:
 - select slowly three brands in the brand refinement list
 - go back once --> goes back right away
 - go back again --> goes a step back (can move forward from there)

This cannot be reproduced there: https://demo.algolia.com/instant-search-demo/
